\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R78-first-pass-describing-words-and-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a country and a story.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item sweet, fat, light, heavy, right
  \item important, beautiful, green, yellow, red
  \item blue, black, white, a week, a year
  \item a minute, today, yesterday, tomorrow, now
  \item always, sometimes, early, late, before
  \item morning, night, a day, far, near
  \item inside, outside, up, down, in front
  \item here, there, right; true, left, a street
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Sweet? (\textbf{\fa{شیرین}}, \emph{shirin}.) Fat? (\textbf{\fa{چاق}}, \emph{châgh}.) Light? (\textbf{\fa{سبک}}, \emph{sabok}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\fa{سنگین}}, \emph{sangin}.) Right? (\textbf{\fa{درست}}, \emph{dorost}.) Important? (\textbf{\fa{مهم}}, \emph{mohem}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{\fa{زیبا}}, \emph{zibâ}.) Green? (\textbf{\fa{سبز}}, \emph{sabz}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\fa{زرد}}, \emph{zard}.) Red? (\textbf{\fa{قرمز}}, \emph{ghermez}.) Blue? (\textbf{\fa{آبی}}, \emph{âbi}.) Black? (\textbf{\fa{سیاه}}, \emph{siyâh}.) White? (\textbf{\fa{سفید}}, \emph{sefid}.) A week? (\textbf{\fa{هفته}}, \emph{hafte}.) A year? (\textbf{\fa{سال}}, \emph{sâl}.) A minute? (\textbf{\fa{دقیقه}}, \emph{daghighe}.) Today? (\textbf{\fa{امروز}}, \emph{emruz}.) Yesterday? (\textbf{\fa{دیروز}}, \emph{diruz}.) Tomorrow? (\textbf{\fa{فردا}}, \emph{fardâ}.) Now? (\textbf{\fa{حالا}}, \emph{hâlâ}.) Always? (\textbf{\fa{همیشه}}, \emph{hamishe}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\fa{گاهی}}, \emph{gâhi}.) Early? (\textbf{\fa{زود}}, \emph{zud}.) Late? (\textbf{\fa{دیر}}, \emph{dir}.) Before? (\textbf{\fa{قبل}}, \emph{ghabl}.) Morning? (\textbf{\fa{صبح}}, \emph{sobh}.) Night? (\textbf{\fa{شب}}, \emph{shab}.) A day? (\textbf{\fa{روز}}, \emph{ruz}.) Far? (\textbf{\fa{دور}}, \emph{dur}.) Near? (\textbf{\fa{نزدیک}}, \emph{nazdik}.) Inside? (\textbf{\fa{داخل}}, \emph{dâkhel}.) Outside? (\textbf{\fa{بیرون}}, \emph{birun}.) Up? (\textbf{\fa{بالا}}, \emph{bâlâ}.) Down? (\textbf{\fa{پایین}}, \emph{pâyin}.) In front? (\textbf{\fa{جلو}}, \emph{jolow}.) Here? (\textbf{\fa{اینجا}}, \emph{injâ}.) There? (\textbf{\fa{آنجا}}, \emph{ânjâ}.) Right; true? (\textbf{\fa{راست}}, \emph{râst}.) Left? (\textbf{\fa{چپ}}, \emph{chap}.) A street? (\textbf{\fa{خیابان}}, \emph{khiyâbân}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R78-second-pass-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bank and a station.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bank, a station, a car, a bus, a train
  \item a bridge, a mosque, a hotel, an office, the police
  \item a boat, a bicycle, a bazaar, a village, a city
  \item an airport, a restaurant, clothes, a shirt, trousers
  \item a sock, a pocket, a ring, a hat, a shoe
  \item a jacket, a belt, twelve, fourteen, sixteen
  \item seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, thirty, forty
  \item fifty, a thousand, the world, a colour, a song
  \item a journey, music, news, a country, a story
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bank? (\textbf{\fa{بانک}}, \emph{bânk}.) A station? (\textbf{\fa{ایستگاه}}, \emph{istgâh}.) A car? (\textbf{\fa{ماشین}}, \emph{mâshin}.) A bus? (\textbf{\fa{اتوبوس}}, \emph{otobus}.) A train? (\textbf{\fa{قطار}}, \emph{ghatâr}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\fa{پل}}, \emph{pol}.) A mosque? (\textbf{\fa{مسجد}}, \emph{masjed}.) A hotel? (\textbf{\fa{هتل}}, \emph{hotel}.) An office? (\textbf{\fa{اداره}}, \emph{edâre}.) The police? (\textbf{\fa{پلیس}}, \emph{polis}.) A boat? (\textbf{\fa{قایق}}, \emph{ghâyegh}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\fa{دوچرخه}}, \emph{docharkhe}.) A bazaar? (\textbf{\fa{بازار}}, \emph{bâzâr}.) A village? (\textbf{\fa{روستا}}, \emph{rustâ}.) A city? (\textbf{\fa{شهر}}, \emph{shahr}.) An airport? (\textbf{\fa{فرودگاه}}, \emph{forudgâh}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\fa{رستوران}}, \emph{resturân}.) Clothes? (\textbf{\fa{لباس}}, \emph{lebâs}.) A shirt? (\textbf{\fa{پیراهن}}, \emph{pirâhan}.) Trousers? (\textbf{\fa{شلوار}}, \emph{shalvâr}.) A sock? (\textbf{\fa{جوراب}}, \emph{jurâb}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\fa{جیب}}, \emph{jib}.) A ring? (\textbf{\fa{انگشتر}}, \emph{angoshtar}.) A hat? (\textbf{\fa{کلاه}}, \emph{kolâh}.) A shoe? (\textbf{\fa{کفش}}, \emph{kafsh}.) A jacket? (\textbf{\fa{کت}}, \emph{kot}.) A belt? (\textbf{\fa{کمربند}}, \emph{kamarband}.) Twelve? (\textbf{\fa{دوازده}}, \emph{davâzdah}.) Fourteen? (\textbf{\fa{چهارده}}, \emph{chahârdah}.) Sixteen? (\textbf{\fa{شانزده}}, \emph{shânzdah}.) Seventeen? (\textbf{\fa{هفده}}, \emph{hefdah}.) Eighteen? (\textbf{\fa{هجده}}, \emph{hejdah}.) Nineteen? (\textbf{\fa{نوزده}}, \emph{nuzdah}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\fa{سی}}, \emph{si}.) Forty? (\textbf{\fa{چهل}}, \emph{chehel}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\fa{پنجاه}}, \emph{panjâh}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\fa{هزار}}, \emph{hezâr}.) The world? (\textbf{\fa{دنیا}}, \emph{donyâ}.) A colour? (\textbf{\fa{رنگ}}, \emph{rang}.) A song? (\textbf{\fa{آهنگ}}, \emph{âhang}.) A journey? (\textbf{\fa{سفر}}, \emph{safar}.) Music? (\textbf{\fa{موسیقی}}, \emph{musighi}.) News? (\textbf{\fa{خبر}}, \emph{khabar}.) A country? (\textbf{\fa{کشور}}, \emph{keshvar}.) A story? (\textbf{\fa{داستان}}, \emph{dâstân}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
